NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[The Estée Lauder Companies Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.elcompanies.com%2Finvestors&esheet=54626446&newsitemid=20261021483407&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Est%26eacute%3Be+Lauder+Companies+Inc&index=1&md5=0079be1f507a9e9d21fa136675b782c1) . (NYSE: EL) today announced that it will webcast presentations from its Capital Markets Experience: China Ecosystem Immersion in Shanghai, China, on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. The event will feature presentations from Stéphane de La Faverie, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Akhil Shrivastava, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, as well as members of the Company’s Executive Leadership Team and local leaders. The presentations will highlight the Company’s strategy and capabilities in China, Beauty Reimagined in action, and how China serves as a blueprint for deploying the Company’s global capabilities to drive sustainable growth and stronger profitability.


Due to limited capacity, in-person attendance is by invitation only.


Interested parties can access the live webcast on Wednesday, November 4th, beginning at 1:00 p.m. China Standard Time (12:00 a.m. ET) at[Investors – The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.elcompanies.com%2Fen%2Finvestors&esheet=54626446&newsitemid=20261021483407&lan=en-US&anchor=Investors+%26%238211%3B+The+Est%26eacute%3Be+Lauder+Companies+Inc.&index=2&md5=4333e1005522b325d70bdc21e400fd29) A replay of the webcast will be archived on the site.


[The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.elcompanies.com%2F&esheet=54626446&newsitemid=20261021483407&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Est%26eacute%3Be+Lauder+Companies+Inc.&index=3&md5=fa21945257bfe8a7a99332e12a747931) is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The Company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands, including The Ordinary, NIOD, Avestan and Loopha, and Balmain Beauty.
